description: Publish a passage after you have already paid the quoted units. Pass the transaction hash, rail, and asset. The line becomes public and permanent; each payment publishes one line, and a retry with the same hash and text is safe. This tool does not send funds. On success it returns a share link for the new line.

by.description: Optional name or pen name. Blank becomes anon.

hash.description: Transaction hash, Bitcoin txid, or Solana signature of the payment.

rail.description: Rail the payment was sent on.

text.description: The passage, 20 to 800 characters after trimming.

name: submit_paid_line
title: Publish a paid line
